title: Software Engineer II - Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM)
description:
About Abnormal AI
Abnormal AI is the leading AI-native security platform, protecting enterprise organizations from the full spectrum of cyber attacks. Powered by behavioral AI that understands human and machine identity, Abnormal detects and prevents attacks that evade traditional security tools - from sophisticated email threats to identity compromise and SaaS application abuse.
Trusted by more than 2,500 enterprises - including over 25% of the Fortune 500 - Abnormal processes billions of identity signals daily to protect people, data at scale.
Why this role exists
To address rapidly escalating customer demand, the BIS organization is growing its team dedicated to Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM). ISPM provides ongoing tracking of an enterprise's identity setups-including Okta, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Entra-revealing hidden vulnerabilities that build up across these networks. It packages these insights into an intuitive, actionable format, empowering security teams to understand their current defense status and prioritize critical remediation efforts.
With identity now serving as the main attack vector for modern enterprises, having complete visibility to understand every identity in your environment and proactively eliminate risk before it's exploited is more essential than ever. As one of Abnormal's fastest-growing divisions, ISPM is seeking a Software Engineer to help build the next generation of identity security defenses.
About the role
This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of identity security and distributed systems engineering. You'll write code, build and scale backend services, and contribute to technical designs - while partnering closely with senior engineers and Product Management to deliver what we build next.
You'll work across the backend: services that continuously evaluate millions of identity configurations, and the data infrastructure that powers posture scoring and proactive risk remediation.
What you'll do
Technical Contribution & Design

• Take well-defined problems from product requirements and deliver backend solutions end-to-end - from data modeling through APIs and evaluation logic.

• Contribute to the design of core identity security posture systems, and author and review technical design documents.

• Participate in architectural discussions and design reviews, raising trade-offs and edge cases.

• Uphold engineering best practices across testing, code quality, API design, and observability.

Software Engineering & Architecture

• Construct and scale high-performance backend services using Go - including event-driven systems, REST/gRPC APIs, cron jobs, and integration layers.

• Design, model, and optimize database schemas capable of handling large-scale multi-tenant identity workloads.

• Implement event-driven workflows using Kafka as a message queue to manage asynchronous processing and ensure continuous evaluation of identity postures.

• Maintain operational reliability and service health through standard runbooks, feature flags, and robust monitoring setups.

Team Collaboration & Delivery

• Collaborate closely with TL,, the EM, and fellow engineers to align on feature scope, prioritize work, and deliver quarterly key results and milestones.

• Participating in on-call rotation, incident response, and SLO management.

• Work autonomously and asynchronously within a distributed team located across India and Singapore.

Must have qualifications

• 4+ years of software development experience, with ~2 years building production-grade backend services.

• Extensive backend production experience with Go - writing idiomatic services with clean design patterns, thorough testing, and robust error handling.

• Good system design skills - experience building and running scalable, multi-tenant, event-driven distributed systems.

• Hands-on experience with Kafka or similar high-throughput event-streaming technologies.

• Strong proficiency in SQL and PostgreSQL - incl

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Зараз ми в пошуку PPC Specialist для однієї з наших портфельних компаній, що створює цифрові сервіси, які допомагають людям простіше працювати з документами, розвивати когнітивні навички та знаходити кращі кар’єрні можливості.

Класні продукти будують не вакансії, а люди. Тому ми не «закриваємо позицію» - ми шукаємо людину, яка підніме планку команди - можливо, це ти.

Які виклики чекають:
- Масштабування - розширення та оптимізація пошукових рекламних кампаній.
- Аналіз зон росту та оптимізація - пошук можливостей для зростання та покращення.
- Локалізація та глобальна експансія - запуск реклами на різних ринках і мовах.
- Автоматизація процесів - використання інструментів для зменшення витрат часу.

 

Що для нас важливо:
- Глибоке розуміння роботи аукціону та інструментів Google Ads.
Досвід роботи з пошуковими кампаніями Google Ads, налаштуванням кампаній, стратегій ставок, оптимізацією та масштабуванням результатів.

description:

Reports to: Dispatch Manager

About Proof

Launched in 2018, Proof is a national platform for service of process supporting thousands of law firms across the United States. We connect law firms with process servers and enable electronic court filing through a modern, technology-driven platform - automating document ingestion, compliance, real-time job matching, and integrations with leading legal software. Today, Proof delivers over 60,000 documents per month through a network of ~2,000 contracted process servers.

About the role

A Dispatch Specialist I is the front line of Proof's marketplace. You ensure all service of process jobs in your territory are successfully dispatched by connecting job opportunities with independent contractor process servers. You negotiate fairly with both clients and servers and learn from every job outcome. Your work directly shapes the client experience, server relationships, and marketplace economics in the territory you own.

What you'll do

• Own a territory. Become the subject-matter expert on the operational requirements (e.g., regional licensing and coverage rules) for the regions you're assigned.

• Keep jobs moving and own your queue. Match every job in your territory to a process server quickly and manage your dispatch requests so work doesn't pile up. Meet SLA targets and make the best decision for our clients and the process servers.

• Build relationships with servers. Servers are independent contractors who choose which jobs to take. Call, text, and email them respectfully and professionally. Take notes on their preferences. Find solutions that work for both sides of the marketplace.

• Communicate with clients. Handle client conversations by phone and email, negotiating the path that works best for everyone.

• Negotiate fair pricing. Set prices that work for the server and the business, and hold the line when it counts.

• Document everything. Keep records of client and server communications and the decisions you made on the job.

• Improve as you go. Spot inefficiencies in your workflow. Share pricing and network gaps with the broader team to strengthen the market.

• Support your peers. Help teammates solve problems when they ask. Contribute to an overall team that runs better because you're on it.

• Use data to learn. Use data and dashboards to track your own performance, identify trends, and improve your decisions and workflows.

Who you are

• A customer-oriented communicator. You're respectful and kind, even when things are hard or moving fast.

• Composed under pressure. Tense conversations don't rattle you. You stay calm and professional.

• Detail-oriented and organized. You don't let things slip through the cracks. Your task queue stays clean. You write clear notes that support your decisions.

• A negotiator. You can hold a price, explain the why, and find creative paths forward when the first option doesn't work.

• Data-curious. You're comfortable opening a dashboard, asking a question, and using the answer to improve your work.

• A team player. You help peers when they ask. You bring ideas to your manager. You make the team better.

• Adaptable. You're comfortable in a fast-paced, changing environment, and you pick up new tools and procedures quickly.

Qualifications

• 1-3 years of professional experience (dispatch, logistics, operations, customer service, or related).

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Comfortable making outbound phone calls every day.

• Experience or natural ability building trust-based relationships, especially with independent contractors or other partners.

• Excellent time management and organizational skills; able to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.

• Comfortable in fast-paced environments with frequent change.

• Proficiency in MacOS and Google Suite (Gmail, Sheets, Docs, Slides).

title: Engineer II ,Software Development
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an Engineer II to join our embedded switching software development team. This entry-level position focuses on developing low-level C software for our managed switches built on Broadcom chipsets, ranging from 10GB to 400GB switching platforms. This role is ideal for recent graduates or early-career engineers passionate about embedded systems and network switching technology.

Key Responsibilities

- Feature Implementation: Implement well-defined switching features in C under senior engineer guidance, including basic L2/L3 protocols

- Driver Development: Contribute to device driver development for Broadcom switching chips and peripheral components

- Protocol Stack: Work on basic network protocol implementations (STP, VLAN, basic routing protocols)

- Testing & Debugging: Develop unit tests and debug embedded software using JTAG, GDB, and hardware debugging tools

- Code Maintenance: Fix bugs in existing switching software and perform code reviews with senior team members

- Documentation: Create and maintain technical documentation for implemented features and protocols

- Hardware Integration: Assist in integrating software with switching hardware platforms across different speed grades

- Performance Testing: Support performance testing and validation of switching features on target hardware

- Learning & Development: Actively learn Broadcom SDK, switching architectures, and embedded systems best practices

Technical Requirements

- C Programming: Strong foundation in C programming, pointers, memory management, and embedded C practices

- Embedded Systems: Basic understanding of embedded systems, real-time operating systems, and hardware-software interfaces

- Network Protocols: Fundamental knowledge of Ethernet, TCP/IP, and basic switching concepts

- Development Tools: Familiarity with GCC, Make, debugging tools (GDB), and version control (Git)

- Operating Systems: Basic understanding of Linux kernel concepts and system programming

- Hardware Understanding: Basic knowledge of computer architecture, memory systems, and I/O interfaces

Switching Domain Knowledge (Training Provided)

- Willingness to learn switching architectures, ASIC programming, and packet processing concepts

- Interest in network protocols and enterprise switching features

- Basic understanding of OSI model and Ethernet fundamentals

- No prior Broadcom SDK experience required - comprehensive training provided

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field

- 2-4 years of embedded software development experience

- Strong C programming skills demonstrated through coursework or projects

- Understanding of computer systems architecture and embedded systems concepts

- Good debugging and problem-solving skills

You’ll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture.

If you are creative, forward-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR.

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Your Role

The laser amplification chain scales the beam energy needed by our fusion system. Developing it involves complex technical decisions, interdependent teams and requirements that evolve as the programme advances.

We are looking for a Technical Lead - Laser Amplification (f/m/d) to give this function clear direction and accountability. Your mission is to lead the amplification team, critically evaluate technical information and turn stakeholder input into decisions, priorities and a credible development roadmap. What you will do

• Develop, scale, and manage high-value strategic referral channels, focusing on cyber law firms ("breach coaches"), cyber insurance carriers/brokers, and forensic incident response partners.

• Coordinate internal cross-functional support with Finance, Legal, Operations, and Product teams to orchestrate contract execution (Incident Response Services Agreements), deal redlines, and rapid deployment operations.

• Maintain pipeline hygiene, record account activities, and track opportunity updates in Salesforce.

What experience you need

• Qualifying complex leads and driving opportunity conversion

• Demonstrating a strong passion and drive to learn the cybersecurity and breach response industry landscape

Experience by Industrious is a workplace hospitality brand launched by CBRE - built on the idea that where you work should actually feel like somewhere worth showing up to. ABOUT THE ROLE

You're the reason tenants feel like they belong to something. Not just a building, but a community - one with its own energy, its own rituals, and a sense that someone actually cares about how their days go.

As a Senior Community Manager, you design and oversee the full tenant programming experience: from the annual event calendar to day-of execution, from building communications to the tenant app. You lead the team that brings it all to life, and you're accountable for the engagement numbers that show it's working.

This role requires the creativity to design programs people actually want to attend, the operational discipline to run them well, and the relationship skills to make tenants feel personally connected to the building. The programming is the vehicle. The feeling is the product.

At buildings where this role works well, tenants renew leases partly because of what you've built. That's the bar.

WINNING IN THIS ROLE MEANS

• Tenants show up. Event attendance is strong, app engagement is growing, and the building has a reputation for actually doing things worth coming to.

• Tenant relationships feel personal. People know your name, tell you things, and trust that you'll follow through.

• You understand that community doesn't happen by accident. You've built programs that worked and ones that didn't, and you learned from both. You have a framework for what drives engagement and why.

• You lead through relationships, not authority. Your direct reports work hard because they want to, not because you've told them to. You invest in people and it shows.

• You're genuinely curious about your tenants. You know what companies are in your building, what they're working on, what they care about. That knowledge makes your programming better and your relationships stickier.

NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF

• You'd rather stay behind the scenes than be the face of a program. This role requires daily visibility and genuine warmth in person.

• Predictable routines appeal to you more than dynamic, fast-moving days.

• You don't see community programming as central to building value. Here, it's one of the primary drivers of tenant retention.

title: Workforce Modernization Architect
description:
Career Team is a leading workforce development organization on a mission to transform lives. We blend cutting-edge technology with compassionate, high-touch services to drive real, measurable outcomes in the lives of job seekers across the country. At Career Team, we’re solving today’s unemployment challenges with smart software, world-class trainers, dedicated case managers, dynamic job developers, and innovative partners. If you're passionate about making a difference and believe in the power of technology to transform lives, you’ll feel right at home here.

Career Team is looking for a Workforce Modernization Architect who designs solutions around people, processes, and compliance; not code. Many of Career Team's customers run federally funded workforce development programs. These programs must submit reports to federal agencies in strictly defined formats, such as the WIOA Participant Individual Record Layout (PIRL), and follow detailed logic rules. You'll make sure our government software platform is built to meet those requirements from the start, translate federal reporting specifications into clear business rules, work with technical teams to make sure the system calculates and formats data correctly, and help customers submit accurate, on-time reports.
Role Overview:

•
Own federal reporting requirements. Interpret federal reporting specifications, data standards, and program guidance, with a focus on PIRL and related U.S. Department of Labor and Department of Education reporting. Turn them into detailed functional requirements.

•
Define reporting logic. Write clear, testable business rules for how the system must calculate each reported value. This includes:

• Reporting periods and date ranges

• Who counts in each reporting population, including participants, exiters, and co-enrollments across WIOA titles (Title I, Title II, Title III, Title IV)

• Unduplicated counts and deduplication

• Enrollment, program participation, and exit logic

• Age and status calculated as of specific dates

• Handling of missing, refused, or conflicting data

•
Specify output formats. Document required file layouts, field definitions, code lists, ordering, and file naming conventions (CSV, XML, fixed-width, or agency-specific templates) so exports pass federal validation the first time.

•
Solve compliance issues. Find the root cause of reporting and compliance problems, whether they come from system logic, data entry, or unclear guidance, and lead them through to a documented fix.

•
Resolve ambiguity. Identify gaps or contradictions in federal guidance. Research agency FAQs, TEGLs, and technical assistance resources. Document how the system handles edge cases and the reasoning behind each decision.

•
Lead testing and quality assurance. Build test scenarios and expected results for reporting logic. Partner with QA to review system outputs against specifications and federal validation tools, such as DOL's WIPS edit checks. Trace errors back to the rule or data that caused them.

•
Bridge state case management systems. Apply your knowledge of how different state case management systems capture and structure participant data. Anticipate integration, mapping, and consistency challenges across customers in multiple states.

•
Track regulatory change. Monitor updates to federal specifications, PIRL versions, and reporting cycles. Assess how changes affect the system and customers, and plan updates ahead of deadlines.

•
Build data quality in. Recommend intake workflows, required fields, and validation checks that keep bad data out of the system, instead of fixing it at report time.

•
Support customers during reporting cycles. Help program staff understand their reports, troubleshoot validation errors, and answer questions from grant managers, monitors, and auditors.

Qualifications:

• Experience in workforce development, including programmatic experience in at least one WIOA program: Title I (Adult, Dislocated Worker, Youth), Title II

100x Hospitality builds VIP packages, travel packages, and destination events for major touring artists, festivals, and live entertainment partners. title: Synthetic Population Engineer
description:
The Synthetic Population Engineer uses cutting edge data science techniques to continuously improve the Epistemix synthetic population. A synthetic population is a statistically representative model of a population of real people and their environment, including personal attributes, social connections, and associations between people and places. These datasets empower customers to solve problems in domains where empirical data is unavailable due to legitimate concerns for personal privacy or where desired data simply does not exist. The Synthetic Population Engineer contributes to profitable growth by making the synthetic population more useful and accessible to customers, increasing adoption and utilization. Having a synthetic population that is continuously updated and improved over time is critical to building trust in the models and solutions built with our platform.
About Epistemix
The most consequential decisions in public health, life sciences, insurance, and enterprise strategy share a common problem: they involve human behavior, network effects, and downstream effects that cannot be safely tested before action is taken. Traditional analytical techniques built on historical data were not built for this. Epistemix was.
We build simulation and data-driven modeling tools that let leaders visualize how strategies will unfold across populations and systems before they commit resources. By clarifying which variables drive outcomes, where leverage exists, and how they interact, we help organizations move from uncertainty to conviction. Getting these decisions right means faster interventions, better-allocated resources, and measurable improvements in human and economic outcomes. We exist to make that possible.
Our platform gives organizations access to realistic, high-resolution population data and the modeling infrastructure to run scenario planning at scale. Together, these capabilities let decision-makers stress-test strategies in a controlled environment before deploying them in the real world across healthcare, consumer industries, insurance, and government. We are approaching our Series B and actively building the team that will define what comes next.
Responsibilities

• Identify and evaluate empirical datasets and use them to enrich the synthetic population to enable new use cases, including through adding new individual attributes and detailed social networks.

• Utilize simulation techniques, including ABMs, to project future demographic trends.

• Improve the geographical plausibility of synthetic environments, ensuring realistic placement of homes, workplaces, schools, and other points of interest (e.g., along roads, close to real world population centers).

• Expand the geographical region covered by the Epistemix synthetic population, with the goal of creating a fully integrated and consistent representation of the global population.

• Create visualizations for marketing and productizing synthetic populations.

• Develop innovative methods for supporting external users in augmenting Epistemix synthetic populations with their own proprietary data.

• Work with external vendors and marketplaces to expand the ecosystem of data providers that can be integrated with the synthetic population.

• Support the synthetic populations team in engaging with customer success, professional services, and engineering teams to understand project specific synthetic population requirements.

Qualifications

•
Proficient experience in:

• Using Python for data science applications.

• Working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL (additional database management experience preferred).

• Working with geospatial data.

• Working with simulation or machine learning models.

• Demonstrate empathy for users and decision makers by explaining how the synthetic population was created (e.g., which data sources and models were used) in an accessible way for all.

• Possessing the passion to build the standard for synthetic populations

Allied Roofing Partners

Remote | Full-Time | Hourly
$18.00-$22.00 per hour, based on experience

ABOUT THE ROLE

A Customer Experience (CX) Specialist is often the first person a homeowner talks to-whether they've called, filled out a web form, or clicked a social ad.

The CX Specialist role is designed to make sure customers hear back in minutes, not hours. CX will also help existing customers with questions and/or basic information as needed.

This role blends customer service and appointment setting. You'll work from proven scripts and playbooks while bringing real listening and judgment to every call.

You'll start by supporting Capstone Roofing, with room to grow into other brands and tools as our CX team expands.

Our goal is simple: Homeowners feel supported, not processed.

POSITION DETAILS

• Location: Remote - United States(preferred Pst TIme)
• Employment Type: Full-Time, Hourly
• Compensation: $18.00-$22.00 per hour, based on experience
• Schedule: Daytime business hours, with evening and Saturday coverage during peak season
• Overtime available
• Reports to: Assistant Director, Customer Experience

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Outbound - Appointment Setting & Recovery

• Call back homeowners who reached out but haven't booked and get them scheduled.
• Work our recovery list of missed calls and unworked web leads. These are a high priority because they are leads we've already paid for.
• When time allows, re-engage past quotes, older estimates, and past customers to help fill the calendar further out.

Inbound Customer Experience

• Answer inbound calls from homeowners requesting to book an inspection or estimate.
• Assist existing customers with job-related or basic questions.
• Respond to new website and social media leads within minutes.
• Log every interaction in the CRM.
• Transfer billing questions finance team.

Expectations

• Follow our calling cadence, scripts, and playbooks while adapting with good judgment when a situation calls for it.
• Meet daily and weekly targets for response speed, contact rate, and appointments booked.
• Provide a professional, friendly, and helpful experience during every customer interaction.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

• Phone-based customer service, appointment setting, inside sales, or call-center experience, including experience working with scripts or playbooks.
• Clear, confident, and friendly phone presence.
• Persistent without being pushy.
• Empathy, patience, and quick thinking with the ability to respond thoughtfully rather than react.
• Strong comfort with technology and the ability to learn and move between a CRM, dialer or softphone, and other tools as they evolve.
• Self-discipline and the ability to work productively from home.
• Quiet, professional home workspace with reliable high-speed internet.
• Coachable and goal-driven mindset.
• Authorization to work in the United States.

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience in roofing, home services, or another trades or contractor business.
• Bilingual with conversational Spanish.
• Previous lead-recovery calling experience.

YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

Weeks 1-2

• Learn Capstone's scripts and systems.
• Shadow live calls.
• Begin handling inbound calls with support.

By Day 30

• Handle inbound calls independently.
• Begin working the recovery list.

By Day 90

• Consistently meet contact-rate and appointment-setting targets across inbound, recovery, and re-engagement work.

At Volga Partners , we’re connecting experienced healthcare professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.
We’re seeking physicians, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants who can apply their clinical knowledge, independent judgment, and evidence-based reasoning to evaluate AI-generated medical information.
This isn’t a traditional healthcare position. You won’t be providing direct patient care or managing a caseload. Instead, you’ll assess complex medical scenarios, challenge inaccurate conclusions, identify gaps in reasoning, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.
Your clinical expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Indian D2C education is large, fragmented, and unit-economics-fragile. Many D2C brands hit the same wall around Series A - CAC too high, retention choppy, next growth chapter requires institutional channel or bundling. That inflection point is your hunting ground. You speak with founders, growth heads, and BD heads at Indian D2C edtechs (subscription apps, parent-tutor marketplaces, AI-tutor brands), plus partnership heads at banks, NBFCs, and telcos exploring education bundles. You qualify their B2B-readiness, identify the right IME engagement pathway (Research / Decide / Validate / Scale) or portfolio fit, and hand off to the LSM team. These are peer conversations with founders - not vendor pitches.

Responsibilities:

• Build and maintain the canonical Indian D2C education master list (~250 brands) plus the bank/NBFC/telco partnership list (~50 counterparties).

• Run multi-touch outbound sequences (LinkedIn + email primary, WhatsApp once warm) to founders, growth heads, and BD heads.

• Reach 50-80 founder / growth-head conversations per month.

• Apply the D2C-variant of the qualifying questionnaire - D2C unit economics, B2B intent, channel readiness, product portability into school/edupreneur context.

• Identify D2C brands at the 'B2B pivot' inflection point - these are highest-conversion prospects.

• Recommend an engagement pathway per qualified prospect - IME Research, Decide, Validate, or Scale, or portfolio-fit partnership.

• Track and act on funding signals - every Series A announcement in Indian edtech is a 7-day follow-up window.

• Coordinate event-driven follow-ups around YourStory TechSparks, EdTech Review summits, NASSCOM Product Conclave.

Requirements
Skills Required:

• 3-5 years of B2B inside sales / BD with D2C, consumer-tech, or startup exposure.

• Comfort speaking with Indian D2C founders in peer register - this is not a vendor pitch.

• Working knowledge of the Indian D2C education landscape and the D2C unit-economics vocabulary (CAC, LTV, payback, churn, MAU, DAU).

• Strong written-English skills for LinkedIn DMs and founder-style emails.

• Pattern-recognition for pivot-point signals - funding + hiring + product-pivot together signals readiness.

• Prior experience inside an Indian D2C edtech or consumer-tech startup.

• Awareness of recent Indian edtech funding, M&A, and down-round activity.

• Working familiarity with the IME 4-tier productised architecture (IME Research / Decide / Validate / Scale).

Benefits
Benefits Offered:

• Competitive fixed plus performance-linked incentive, paid monthly.

• Direct relationships with the next wave of Indian D2C edtech founders.

• Cohort learning with extended 90-day ramp.

• Path to Senior ISM, Cohort Lead, or D2C-vertical LSM / strategy roles.

title: Senior Product Manager, Shared Hosting

Who We Are
At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support.
Shared hosting is the foundation of our business. It is where most of our customers begin, where millions of small businesses and creators keep their websites running every day, and where the durability of our relationship with them is decided. This is not a greenfield product - it is a large, mature, revenue-critical platform with real customers, real constraints, and enormous leverage in every point of retention we earn back.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the strategy and roadmap for our shared hosting platform, with a clear mandate: make the experience after purchase so good that customers stay.
Most of the hosting industry competes on the first 60 seconds - the price on the landing page. We intend to win on everything that happens afterward: how quickly a customer gets a working site, how rarely they need to contact support, how confidently they understand what they are paying for, and whether they renew. You will own that journey end to end, and you will be measured on retention, not on shipped features.
This is a role for a product manager who is energized rather than intimidated by a large legacy platform, who reads support transcripts for fun, and who understands that in a high-volume, low-ARPU business, a one-point improvement in renewal rate is worth more than most new products.
What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark.
Own the strategy and roadmap

• Define and own the multi-quarter vision, strategy, and roadmap for the shared hosting platform across brands, and get real alignment on it from engineering through executive leadership.

• Make explicit, defensible prioritization calls about where we invest - and where we deliberately do not - in a portfolio with more legitimate demands than capacity.

• Build the business cases that unlock investment: sizing, cohort impact modeling, and a credible view of payback.

Own retention as a product problem

•
Diagnose churn properly. Separate first-term churn from renewal-term churn, voluntary from involuntary, price-driven from experience-driven - then build a roadmap that attacks the largest addressable causes rather than the loudest ones.

•
Fix the renewal moment. Introductory-to-renewal price transitions are the single largest churn event in this industry. Partner with pricing, billing, and lifecycle marketing to make renewal transparent, well-timed, and defensible on value rather than surprising.

•
Recover involuntary churn. Own the product surface of failed payments, expiring cards, dunning, and reactivation - some of the highest-ROI work available on a subscription base this size.

•
Reduce refund and cancellation rate inside the money-back guarantee window by finding and removing the specific early-life failures that cause it.

Own the customer experience end to end

•
Compress time-to-first-published-site. Own provisioning, onboarding, domain connection, and the first-session experience. Every day between purchase and a live site is a day of churn risk.

•
Modernize the control panel experience. Shape the customer-facing evolution of our hosting management experience - including the migration path off cPanel-era tooling - with usability and continuity for existing customers as first-order constraints, not afterthoughts.

•
Attack support contact drivers. Partner with Customer Care to identify the top reasons customers contact us - DNS and domain confusion, email deliverability, performance complaints, malware remediation, billing questions, migration failures - and convert contact-rate reduction into a funded product roadmap. Lower contact rate and higher satisfaction are the same work done well.

title: Senior Salesforce Admin (India- Remote)
description:
Description
About the Role
The Salesforce Administrator owns and optimizes our Salesforce platform - a mature, heavily automated environment spanning Sales Cloud and Service Cloud. You will manage significant custom configuration, a body of existing legacy automation, and numerous critical integrations (NetSuite, marketing automation, e-signature, telephony, and more).
This is a hands-on role for a skilled administrator who can configure declaratively, keep our integration ecosystem healthy, and translate cross-functional business needs into reliable, scalable solutions. We actively manage and extend this org using AI-assisted tooling (including Claude Code) , so we are especially interested in someone who already leverages AI to streamline administration or is genuinely driven to work in an AI-forward setup.
Key Responsibilities
System Administration & Security

• Serve as the primary system administrator for Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.

• Manage user lifecycle, roles, profiles, permission sets, field-level security, and sharing rules.

• Support end users with troubleshooting, training, and documentation to drive adoption across departments.

Automation & Process Modernization

• Design, build, and maintain complex declarative automation using Salesforce Flow (record-triggered, screen, scheduled, and HTTP callout flows).

• Audit, rationalize, and retire legacy Workflow Rules and Process Builders into clean, maintainable Flows.

• Administer Service Cloud processes, including Case assignment rules, queue management, and automated offboarding cases tied to client cancellations.

Integrations & Ecosystem Management

• Own and maintain integrations across connected platforms, including NetSuite (via Celigo / ) , GoHighLevel, PDF Butler (e-signature/doc-gen), Dialpad, Apollo, HubSpot (sunset phase), and Outlook/Teams sync.

• Configure and support custom API- and webhook-based integrations to ensure uninterrupted data flow across systems.

Deployments, Data Hygiene & Analytics

• Manage deployments across sandboxes and production using the Metadata API, Salesforce CLI, or Change Sets , troubleshooting test-coverage and deployment failures.

• Build and maintain reports and dashboards supporting pipeline, subscription-revenue metrics ( MRR, ARR, churn ), and operational decision-making.

• Ensure data hygiene through validation rules, deduplication, and regular audits (e.g., lead-source completeness, duplicate resolution).

AI & Innovation

• Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT) to accelerate Flow design, formula building, metadata analysis, documentation, and troubleshooting.

• Stay current on Salesforce releases, features, and best practices to propose continuous system improvements.

Requirements
Required Skills & Experience

•
Experience: 8 years of dedicated experience as a Salesforce Administrator in a complex, heavily automated environment. Experience in healthcare, marketing, or agency/managed services environments is a strong plus.

•
Certifications: Salesforce Administrator certification required. Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Platform Developer I (PDI) strongly preferred.

•
Core Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of the Salesforce data model, security architecture, and Flow Builder (including HTTP callouts and complex sub-flows).

•
Cloud Knowledge: Hands-on administration experience across both Sales Cloud and Service Cloud (Case management).

•
Integrations: Experience owning third-party and custom integrations, including middleware/iPaaS (e.g., Celigo / ) and REST/Webhook syncs. Experience with NetSuite or marketing tech stacks is a major advantage.

•
Analytics: Strong proficiency with custom report types, bucket fields, and dashboards; comfort with SaaS metrics (MRR/ARR/churn) preferred.

•
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Senior Elixir Engineer
description:
Senior Elixir Engineerat Vic.ai Remote
Location: Remote
This is a fully remote position, full-time, with flexible working hours and work arrangements.
About Vic.ai

Vic.ai is creating the “Intelligent Accounting” era, using artificial intelligence to automate accounting and provide advisory, business insight, and eventually business foresight .
We’re a Series A stage start-up, founded by three Norwegian entrepreneurs and backed by renowned Silicon Valley investors (including Costanoa Ventures, Cowboy Ventures, and GGV Capital).
We’re US-based, but our team is global, from New Zealand to California. We’re bringing AI to Finance and Accounting because the industry is ripe for automation and big-data insight and the market is huge: $200B just in the US.
Our main office locations is in New York. We have a well established remote-work culture, and over 50% of our team are working fully remote.
We have a solid team of very experienced, yet humble, Elixir engineers, will you be our next team member?
About you
You’ve been a software engineer for 5+ years, but you’ve been a tinkerer and a builder your whole life. We’re a team of builders-when we aren’t building Vic.ai , we’re tinkering with a personal project, contributing to open source, modding a drone, building a computer from components, etc.
We’re looking for an experienced developer who enjoys working with server-side technologies. You possess a good mixture of DevOps and application development skills and would like to build innovative solutions with experienced teammates in a flexible environment.
You should have plenty of experience in building performant, easy to use, well-monitored, and well tested APIs, designing efficient data flows, communicating clearly, sharing knowledge, and questioning existing solutions.
You’re ready for the next step in your career, ready to take on fast-moving challenges. You’re enthusiastic about AI and the possibilities it opens for software development and transforming traditional work. You aim at reaching greatness and delivering exceptional outcomes in your work.
As a team player, you are not afraid of reaching out to your colleagues to discuss development challenges, especially when you are stuck trying to solve a specific issue.
You are fluent in English.
Job Requirements

• Advanced Elixir programming experience is a must

• Solid understanding of working in Linux shells

• Ability to spin up servers, setting them up and make them available for application deploys

• Having great understanding of the value of automated tests, and ability to implement them across the whole stack

• Designing efficient deploy flows and continuous integration

• Solid knowledge of key-value stores, SQL, and relational databases; preferably PostgreSQL

• Ability to implement and maintain robust concurrent background job systems, having a grasp of concurrency patterns and message queues

• Fluent English, spoken and written, clear and effective daily communication with the team

What you’ll do

• Build and deploy high-uptime products and infrastructure as part of the Vic.ai platform

• Integrate Elixir systems with non-uptime-critical systems in Python

• Design and establish validation, testing, correctness, and resilience best practices across teams

• Ship products and services as part of a small, collaborative team

• Help establish engineering process, tools, and systems that will allow us to scale the code base, productivity, and the team

Who we're looking for:

• BS (or higher) in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent technical experience

• 5+ years of relevant work experience

• Professional experience with Elixir programming language

• Track record of shipping high-quality products and features

• Ability to turn business needs into engineering solutions

As an early employee, you'll be working with a small team of committed and talented engineers and having a large, long-term impact on technical design and engineering culture.

We're looking for a Financial Systems Lead to own the financial-systems strategy and execution across our network of companies. You'll design and implement ERP solutions, evaluate financial-systems tools and platforms, advise leadership on technology investments, and ensure each company has the systems and processes to manage its own finances effectively.
This is an individual contributor role focused on strategy, design, and hands-on execution. You'll work directly with company finance teams and implementation partners, troubleshoot technical problems, establish best practices, and build the financial-systems foundation that enables our companies to operate independently.
You'll have significant influence over how we approach financial systems across the network. As we grow, you'll build and lead a small team. We're looking for someone who can handle the immediate hands-on work while growing into broader leadership of this function.

Senior Energy Engineering Consultant (Senior SEM Coach)
CLEAResult ’s Strategic Energy Management (SEM) team is growing, and we’re looking for a Senior SEM Coach to guide energy teams at large commercial, institutional and industrial facilities through continuous improvement. Your main role is to coach plant and facility staff to find, evaluate and implement energy savings. You’ll manage multiple customer engagements at once and bring a strong understanding of energy-using systems such as central plants, HVAC, lighting and process loads. You will also merge the technical with the human element to add value for each customer site. The aim is to help each participant build lasting energy management practices and measurable savings.

Key Responsibilities

• Coach and motivate facility and plant teams, from operators to senior management, to adopt SEM practices and sustain energy savings.

• Deliver SEM engagements per the CA SEM Design Guide, including workshops, one-on-one coaching, energy-use baselining and tracking, and site improvement plans.

• Manage multiple concurrent projects and participant companies, keeping schedules, milestones and savings goals on track and escalating issues early.

• Facilitate training workshops, onsite energy audits and site walk-throughs to identify energy savings opportunities.

• Analyze system and process performance using monitoring equipment, utility data and statistical analysis.

• Write clear reports and recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.

• Build client trust and show the value of SEM so participants stay engaged and savings keep growing.

• Mentor junior coaches and help refine SEM tools and materials.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field (Master’s preferred).

• 8+ years of relevant experience in energy efficiency, facilities or industrial operations, including experience with energy-using systems at large commercial and/or industrial sites.

• Proven project management skills, including managing multiple projects at once.

• Strong interpersonal, coaching and facilitation skills, with the ability to work with different personalities and drive results.

• Proficiency in Excel (formulas, charting, data interpretation), Word (styles, cross-referencing, professional layout) and PowerPoint (slide masters, consistent branding, clear and engaging design).

Preferred

• Certified Energy Manager (CEM) or Professional Engineer (PE) license.

• Experience with continuous improvement, change management, or Lean/Six Sigma principles.

• Prior SEM coaching experience and statistical modeling skills.

$100,000 - $120,000

title: Ingénieur en Intégration de Composants Haute Tension (Full Remote)(H/F/X)
description:
Aperçu de l’entreprise
TMC est un cabinet de conseil de premier plan spécialisé dans la fourniture de connaissances spécialisées en physique, logiciel, nanotechnologie et science des données. Nous permettons aux entreprises d’innover et de garder une longueur d’avance sur le marché concurrentiel en tirant parti des technologies de pointe et des progrès scientifiques.
Titre du poste
Ingénieur en Intégration de Composants Haute Tension (H/F/X)
Localisation
Full Remote, Europe
Nous recherchons un ingénieur spécialisé dans l'intégration de composants haute tension pour rejoindre notre équipe. Votre rôle consistera à développer et à intégrer des composants électriques de haute tension dans nos produits, en assurant leur conformité aux normes et spécifications techniques.
En tant qu'ingénieur en intégration de composants haute tension, vous serez responsable des tâches suivantes :

• Créer une fiche produit pour les nouveaux composants haute tension (HV) : Il s'agit de créer une documentation décrivant les spécifications, les caractéristiques et d'autres informations pertinentes sur les composants haute tension à intégrer.

• Réaliser des examens/révisions techniques : Effectuer des examens techniques approfondis pour s'assurer que l'intégration des composants haute tension répond à toutes les normes, exigences et règles de sécurité nécessaires.

• Élaborer des lignes directrices pour l'installation : Élaborer des lignes directrices détaillées pour l'installation de chaque composant haute tension, couvrant à la fois les interfaces mécaniques et électriques. En outre, créer des documents d'interface fonctionnelle pour garantir une intégration transparente dans l'architecture fonctionnelle globale.

• Suivi des activités fournisseurs : Suivre les activités des fournisseurs, y compris leurs plans de développement, leurs plans de validation de la conception et tous les problèmes qui se posent, ainsi que les plans d'action correspondants pour les résoudre.

• Diffusion de la documentation : Vous serez responsable de la diffusion de la documentation 3D des composants aux parties concernées.

• Créer des spécifications de dessin en 2D : Générer des spécifications de dessin 2D détaillées qui soulignent les dimensions précises, les tolérances et les autres spécifications nécessaires à la fabrication et à l'assemblage.

• Effectuer une analyse des modes de défaillance et de leurs effets (DFMEA) : Réaliser l'AMDE pour identifier et atténuer les modes de défaillance potentiels et leurs effets sur la conception et la fonctionnalité des composants haute tension.

• Soutien aux activités de sign-off et de PEA (Product Engineering Authorization) : Vous apporterez un soutien technique aux activités de sign-off et de PEA , assurer toutes les approbations nécessaires avant et/ou après implémentation (intégration)

En accomplissant ces tâches, vous garantirez l'intégration réussie des composants haute tension dans les projets et les lignes de produits spécifiés, tout en accordant la priorité à la sécurité, à la fonctionnalité et à la conformité aux normes et réglementations en vigueur.
Compétences requises :

• Diplôme d'ingénieur en électrotechnique, génie électrique ou domaine similaire.

• Bonne compréhension des concepts de haute tension et des normes associées.

• Expérience dans le développement et l'intégration de composants électriques.

• Compétences en analyse de risques (DFMEA).

• Capacité à travailler en équipe et à communiquer efficacement.

• Rigueur et souci du détail.

Renseignements supplémentaires
Pour plus de détails sur le rôle, les responsabilités et les qualifications, les candidats intéressés sont invités à visiter la page carrières TMC. Nous sommes un employeur équitable et valorisons la diversité au sein de notre entreprise.

title: NORTH CAROLINA PSYCHIATRIC-MENTAL HEALTH NURSE PRACTITIONER (PMHNP)
description:
NORTH CAROLINA REMOTE PSYCHIATRIC-MENTAL HEALTH NURSE PRACTITIONER (PMHNP)
Initiating Visit & Supervising Practitioner : Principal Illness Navigation, Peer Support (PIN-PS)
Independent Contractor (1099) | Telehealth/ Remote position | You Are Accountable
ABOUT THE ROLE
You Are Accountable operates behavioral health programs built around Principal Illness Navigation - Peer Support (PIN-PS), a Medicare care-navigation benefit in which certified peer support specialists walk alongside patients living with serious behavioral health conditions. Every patient's navigation episode must begin with a qualifying initiating visit furnished by a billing practitioner, and the ongoing peer navigation is billed incident to that practitioner's services under general supervision. That practitioner is you.
This is a flexible, telehealth-based contractor role with meaningful clinical leverage: you conduct the psychiatric evaluation that opens each patient's episode, set the plan of care the peer team supports, and remain available as the supervising clinician while peer specialists deliver month-to-month navigation. You control your own schedule, and compensation scales directly with the work you personally perform.
WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Conduct initiating visits (e.g., psychiatric diagnostic evaluations, CPT 90791, or E/M visits) via telehealth for patients entering PIN-PS programs, establishing the diagnosis, medical necessity, and plan of care the navigation services will support.

• Document each visit in our EHR within 48 hours to clean, billable standards, including patient consent to navigation services where required.

• Serve as the billing practitioner of record for enrolled patients and provide general supervision of the certified peer support specialists furnishing navigation incident to your services.

• Furnish follow-up visits for your enrolled patients where clinically indicated and mutually agreed.

• Cooperate with quality, audit, and payer-compliance activities relating to your patients.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Active, unrestricted APRN/NP licensure in one or more of: Texas, Florida, North Carolina, Tennessee, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, or New York (multi-state licensure a plus). State credential titles vary (APRN, CRNP, APN, NP) - all are welcome.

• National board certification as a Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC).

• Any physician collaboration, supervision, or protocol arrangement required by your state (e.g., prescriptive authority agreement in TX; collaborative agreement in PA; joint protocol in NJ; practice agreement or NP Modernization Act qualification in NY; supervisory protocol in FL) - we can discuss support here. We also have physicians that we work with that can provide this.

• Active NPI; eligibility to enroll with and reassign benefits to our professional entities for Medicare and Medicaid; never excluded from any federal or state health care program.

• Comfort with telehealth care for adults with serious behavioral health conditions, and an appreciation for peer support as part of the care team.

COMPENSATION

• Professional services: 80% of net collections for each service you personally furnish, paid within 30 days after the month we receive payment from the funding source, with full per-service reporting.

• Supervision stipend: $5.00 per supervised patient per month for each month billable navigation services are furnished to that patient under your supervision.

• Malpractice coverage: professional liability coverage for your services under this engagement provided at our expense ($1M per claim / $3M aggregate).

ENGAGEMENT DETAILS
1099 independent contractor; you keep full independent clinical judgment and set your own schedule around agreed availability. The role is non-exclusive - most of our practitioners maintain other practices. title: Sales Enablement Manager
description:
Crystalia Glass LLC is a U.S.-based manufacturer and provider of premium glass solutions, specializing in custom glass partitions for residential, commercial, and institutional projects. We operate a full-cycle model - from design and manufacturing to sales, delivery, and installation - with production facilities in the United States and Europe.
The U.S. market is our core focus. Crystalia Glass is a stable, scaling business, serving B2C, B2B, and B2G clients across multiple states. We combine strong product quality, competitive pricing, high service standards, and operational efficiency to set a benchmark within our industry.
We are strengthening our commercial function and are looking for a Sales Enablement Manager to own the quality of sales execution across the full funnel, from first contact and needs discovery to closing and order handover.
This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Sales Enablement Manager will diagnose why deals are lost, coach sales teams, build and adapt sales standards and CRM stage logic, and embed AI into everyday sales work. Success depends on driving adoption across sales teams and measuring real change in sales representatives’ behavior and conversion.
Employment Type:
- Full-time 8.30 am - 5 pm, NY (EST zone).
- Remote work.
- B2B contract (sole proprietorship status or corporate entity).

Key responsibilities:
Analyze performance

• Review won, lost and stalled deals across funnel stages, matching calls and messages against CRM history and using AI to flag missed questions, weak arguments, unhandled objections and missing next steps.

• Assess each sales stage (discovery, qualification, value presentation, objection handling, negotiation, closing and follow-up), including how scripts are adapted to the client and whether call goals are achieved.

• Identify root causes of performance gaps (skills, knowledge, process or tools) and recommend targeted fixes.

Develop the team

• Run one-to-one and team call and deal reviews, role-plays (including AI-simulated buyers and objections), live call observation and product knowledge checks.

• Build individual development plans and coach sales representatives on specific sales behaviors.

• Coach team leads to apply shared quality criteria in daily work with their teams.

Track results

• Track whether new behaviors and AI workflows are applied in real deals and how they affect conversion, deal outcomes and time spent.
Standards and CRM

• Audit existing sales standards for gaps, contradictions and requirements that don’t help the sale.

• Write and update sales standards: scripts, objection guides, follow-up rules, contact quality criteria and product instructions, as well as CRM stage rules - the goal, entry and exit criteria, required data, sales representative actions and next steps for each stage, ownership at handover, and SLAs agreed with the process owner (response time, working hours, exceptions and escalation).

• Pilot and roll out new standards: incorporate feedback from sales representatives and team leads, agree commercial rules with sales leadership, write requirements for CRM fields, prompts, notifications, reports and automation, take part in acceptance testing, and train sales representatives after changes.

• Monitor adherence to standards in the CRM: overdue tasks, missing next steps, unconfirmed stage moves, missing loss reasons and handover quality.

AI in sales work

• Build reusable AI workflows for sales representatives and team leads (call and meeting preparation, meeting summaries, follow-up messages, discovery question planning and checking proposals against client and product data), train sales teams to use them, observe real usage and fix errors.

• Work with AI agents and bots; maintain instructions, templates and knowledge-base materials.

• Use AI to help sales representatives plan next steps in the CRM, making sure they review every AI-drafted message or data update before it goes to
